question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 the canonical current-file landing path, or ask this PR to be ported from the removed `pi-*` files?
rationale: Both PRs target the same read-image media gap, but this branch is stale and the newer current-file PR is not yet proof-positive, so automation should not close either side as superseded without a human landing-path decision.

options.title: Use current-file shared PR
options.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442's proof, lint, and context blockers, make it explicitly cover the Feishu report, then close or retire this stale old-path branch.

options.title: Ask this PR to port
options.body: Have this contributor refresh the branch against `embedded-agent-subscribe.*`, remove the uncontracted fallback, and add real behavior proof for the updated head.

options.title: Pause both repair PRs
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers decide whether the correct fix should persist image bytes into the media store instead of falling back to start args.

recommendation.title: Use current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442's proof, lint, and context blockers, make it explicitly cover the Feishu report, then close or retire this stale old-path branch.
